description: Drain earlier requests and release the active engine, replay cache and owned resources while retaining investigation Evidence references and complete Unknown history in memory. Optionally save a target-bound analysis snapshot before closing; resource-only sessions have no binary snapshot binding. Later requests wait for this transition. Existing files require overwrite; a failed snapshot save keeps the engine open. Metadata edits prevent snapshot saves until the engine is recreated. Use reset_investigation to clear records explicitly, optionally saving a complete cross-domain Evidence bundle for import in a new process. With Ghidra checkpoint mode enabled, normal close saves Program metadata; a failed save retains the live Program for close retry. Closing does not automatically persist investigation Evidence/Unknown records.
name: close_binary

evidence_records.description: All retained Evidence records, including observations without replay bindings.

title: Close Binary
